findings.title: Grafana list rules lose Pause and Delete actions
findings.body: This new list item passes only `promRule` to the action buttons, so `AlertRuleMenu` receives no `rulerRule`. The menu still gates Pause on a Grafana ruler rule and Delete on `rulerRule` being present, even though this PR now calculates abilities from `promRule` for the ruler-free list. As a result, users cannot pause or delete Grafana rules from this list.

findings.title: Silence action does not open its drawer for Prometheus-only rules
findings.body: The menu now derives silence permission from `promRule`, so it can display Silence for a Grafana rule loaded without a ruler rule. Clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but this condition requires `rule` to be a Grafana ruler alerting rule; in the new list path `rule` is absent, so the drawer never renders and the menu action does nothing.

findings.title: Filtered Grafana rules are rendered without stable React keys
findings.body: The Grafana item returned from this `rules.map` omits the `key` that is already computed for each result. React therefore warns about missing keys and may reuse the wrong item component when results are reconciled, which can associate action state with a different rule.
